segments.heading: Switch (Toggle)
segments.text: The component creates an iOS-style toggle switch using pure CSS (no JavaScript required).

segments.heading: Input Groups
segments.text: Input groups allow you to join inputs with addons like icons, text, buttons, or selects. The class removes inner borders and border radii.

segments.heading: Input Group Sizes
segments.text: Input groups inherit the size from the input controls within them. Apply size modifiers to the input elements to adjust the entire group size.

segments.heading: Form Grid Layout
segments.text: The class creates a responsive grid layout. Forms are single-column on mobile and expand to multiple columns on larger screens.

segments.heading: Inline Form Layout
segments.text: The class places labels and inputs side-by-side in a horizontal layout.

segments.heading: Best Practices
segments.text: Use switches for binary settings : Switches work best for on/off toggles that take effect immediately Group related addons : Keep input group addons simple and focused Grid responsiveness : Forms automatically stack on mobile, expand on tablet+ Floating labels : Best for clean, modern designs with minimal visual weight Input group sizes : Match addon sizes with input sizes for visual consistency

segments.heading: Ghost Variant
segments.text: The ghost variant ( , ) creates borderless inputs that only show borders on hover and focus. Perfect for minimal, clean interfaces. Note : Ghost variant is only available for text inputs and textareas. Select dropdowns maintain their border for usability.

segments.heading: Input Sizes
segments.text: All input controls support three sizes: small ( ), default (no modifier), and large ( ). These size variants also work with selects and textareas.

segments.heading: Textarea
